# Week 2 guide

This week your assistant learns to answer questions about a short document instead of one fixed
question.

1. Write or choose a short document that you are free to share. A page of notes you wrote yourself
   is enough.
2. Change the assistant so that it reads the document and uses it when it answers.
3. Update your `README.md` so that a new reader can set the project up and use it, with two
   sections headed Setup and Usage.

Keep a list of the questions the assistant answers badly. You will need it this week and next.
